title: TamedFlow: Trajectory-Aware Distillation for Teacher-Assisted Diffusion Sampling
title_zh: TamedFlow：面向教师辅助扩散采样的轨迹感知蒸馏

paragraphs.en: 提出TamedFlow方法，通过轨迹感知蒸馏结合模型压缩与自适应推理，破解“组合鸿沟”实现扩散模型加速。 Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver high-fidelity image and video generation, but inference requires many sequential model evaluations. Two acceleration strategies are increasingly important: model compression makes each evaluation cheaper, while adaptive inference avoids selected teacher computation through reuse, forecasting, or speculative execution. Their combination, however, is brittle: directly applying the evaluated adaptive methods to a compressed student can degrade quality, an observed failure mode we call the \textbf{Combination Gap}. We link this gap to a mismatch between pointwise distillation and short-horizon execution: a student trained at teacher states need not remain reliable when its own predictions are chained. We propose \textbf{TamedFlow}, which trains a compressed DiT for this deployed role through cross-architecture feature alignment, a near-identity Velocity Alignment Head, and randomized rollout supervision. At inference, a lightweight Learnable Trajectory Estimator routes completed drafts: accepted drafts bypass the teacher, while rejected drafts roll back and receive one teacher rescue step. Distilling DiT-XL/2 into DiT-B/2, TamedFlow reaches FID $2.58$ at $2.25\times$ measured speedup over DDIM-50 on ImageNet $256\times256$. Ablations support trajectory supervision, and routing controls favor LTE over random decisions at nearly matched latency. Evaluations on ImageNet $512\times512$, MS-COCO, and Latte/FaceForensics extend the empirical scope.
paragraphs.zh: 提出TamedFlow方法，通过轨迹感知蒸馏结合模型压缩与自适应推理，破解“组合鸿沟”实现扩散模型加速。扩散Transformer（DiTs）能够实现高保真的图像和视频生成，但推理需要多次顺序的模型评估。 两种加速策略日益重要：模型压缩使每次评估更廉价，而自适应推理通过复用、预测或投机执行来避免选定的教师模型计算。 然而二者结合十分脆弱：直接将已评估的自适应方法应用于压缩后的学生模型会降低质量，我们将这一观察到的失效模式称为\textbf{组合鸿沟（Combination Gap）}。 我们将这一鸿沟归因于逐点蒸馏与短程执行之间的不匹配：在教师状态上训练的学生模型，在自身预测被链接串联时未必保持可靠。 我们提出\textbf{TamedFlow}，它通过跨架构特征对齐、近恒等的速度对齐头（Velocity Alignment Head）以及随机化滚动监督，针对这一部署角色训练压缩后的DiT。 在推理时，轻量级的可学习轨迹估计器（Learnable Trajectory Estimator）对完成的草稿进行路由：被接受的草稿绕过教师模型，被拒绝的草稿则回滚并接受一步教师救援。 将DiT-XL/2蒸馏到DiT-B/2后，TamedFlow在ImageNet $256\times256$上以相对于DDIM-50实测$2.25\times$的加速达到FID $2.58$。 消融实验支持轨迹监督的有效性，且在延迟几乎相当的情况下，路由控制表明LTE优于随机决策。 在ImageNet $512\times512$、MS-COCO以及Latte/FaceForensics上的评估扩展了实验范围。
